content.title: A Commentary on St. Paul's Epistle to the Galatians (lectures of 1531, printed 1535)
content.author: Martin Luther · abridged translation by Theodore Graebner (Grand Rapids: Zondervan, 1949), CCEL text
content.note: Luther's lectures on Galatians, given in 1531 and printed in 1535. On 3:13 he teaches that Christ, innocent in himself, took the place of sinners and bore their curse. Graebner's abridgment; CCEL records that its copyright was not renewed. Cited and described, not quoted, until its status is checked.
